question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of post-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass in relation to recycled materials?
data_point: mass fraction of post-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass
description: The mass fraction of post-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass refers to the percentage of recycled materials from products that have already been used by consumers, as a part of the overall product mass. This metric is used to assess the amount of post-consumer recycled content in a product, providing a measure of the product's contribution to a circular economy by promoting the reuse and recycling of materials.
